subject: Strange behavior when making slide min max dependent

messages.author: 1b81d9050f0dbe89
messages.subject: Strange behavior when making slide min max dependent
parts:
Dear All,

For teaching purposes I want to be able to have two sliders where the min and max depends on the value of the other slide. The code below works fine except that when I move the slide to some values the marker of the lides starts to jump between two values! So, does this depend on my code or something else? Is there a simpler way to do this? I'm farily new to Shiny as well as to R...

In the example below A and B are parameters restricted to a diamond type of parameter space, so when I change the value of one parameter, the conditional feasible set of the other change. Hence I want the min and max to change such as the slider always yields values within the restrited parameter space.

Best
Johan

ui.R:
library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
 
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Does this work?!"),
  
   sidebarPanel(
   
    uiOutput("sliderA"),
    uiOutput("sliderB")
   
      )
 
    )
  )

server.R:
library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output,session) {
  
# Do this as the first time input$A is not defined 
     output$sliderB <- renderUI({
       if (length(input$A)==0){
         inputA <- 0} else  {
           inputA <- input$A
         }
       if (length(input$B)==0){
         inputB <- 0} else  {
           inputB <- input$B
         }
# Derive the boarders of the restricted parameter space
      if (inputA>0){
        minB <- -1 + 0.5*inputA
        maxB <- 1 -0.5*inputA
      }else if(inputA<=0){
        minB <- -1 -0.5*inputA
        maxB <- 1 +0.5*inputA    
      }
# Have to do this as the slider only can take certain values and if the min and max is changed we will definitely jump back and forth...
      stp <- 0.01
      minB <- stp*(floor(minB/stp)+1)
      maxB <- stp*floor(maxB/stp)
     
    sliderInput(inputId = "B",
                label = "Value of B:",
                min=minB, max=maxB, value=inputB,step = stp)
  })
 
  output$sliderA <- renderUI({
    if (length(input$A)==0){
      inputA <- 0} else  {
        inputA <- input$A
      }
    if (length(input$B)==0){
      inputB <- 0} else  {
        inputB <- input$B
      }
    if (inputB>0){
      minA <- -2 +2*inputB
      maxA <- 2 -2*inputB
    }else if(inputB<=0){
      minA <- -2 -2*inputB
      maxA <- 2 +2*inputB     
    }
    stp <- 0.01
    minA <- stp*(floor(minA/stp)+1)
    maxA <- stp*floor(maxA/stp)
   
    sliderInput(inputId = "A",
                label = "Value of A:",
                min=minA, max=maxA, value=inputA,step = stp)
  })
})
